en:
Monokuma said he wanted us to play 
his killing game no matter what...

But what good does that do him?
What's his goal?
If his only reason is that it's fun, then...

We might be in even more trouble than
we thought.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time discussing
Monokuma's intentions with Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma and I grew a little closer today.
